notes: Sourced from Extron's official spec sheet (media.extron.com, part# 4460-D9, rev D9, 09/28/18) plus the official DTP T HWP/UWP 232/332 D Setup Guide (68-2547-50 Rev B) for physical panel labels/connector counts, since Extron's live product page (extron.com/product/dtptuwp232d) blocks automated fetches. This is a 2-module Decora-style wallplate transmitter that fits a 2-gang wall box (two ~2.7"x3.5"x1.9" modules); the spec sheet's General/Mounting section literally states "Rack mount: Yes, with included rack ears," which contradicts the decora-wallplate physical description elsewhere in the same document and appears to be boilerplate carried over from Extron's DTP product-family template — rackUnits was therefore omitted rather than guessed. This is the standard-definition non-4K "232 D" model (max ~1920x1200/1080p60, 2048x1080p60); do not confuse with the separate "DTP T UWP 4K 232 D" variant, which supports 4K/18Gbps HDMI over a different (thicker) cable spec. HDMI grade (hdmi-1.4) is inferred from stated max pixel clock/data rate, not an explicit HDMI version number in the source — lowering overall confidence to medium. USB port is physically Mini-USB Type B (mapped to usb-b, the closest available enum). Two DTP T UWP 232 D units are shown side-by-side in setup-guide diagrams as separate faceplate modules (HDMI module + VGA module) sharing one rear DTP-out chassis; port list here reflects the combined unit as sold under this single model/part number.

ports.name: HDMI IN
ports.note: Actual max data rate is 6.75 Gbps (2.25 Gbps/color), max pixel clock 165 MHz, resolution up to 1920x1200/1080p60 8-bit or 2048x1080p60 (2K) — below full HDMI 1.4 bandwidth (closer to single-link DVI/HDMI 1.2-1.3 class). hdmi-1.4 chosen as the closest available grade bucket; treat as inferred/approximate, not a manufacturer-stated version number. Also accepts DVI-D via adapter (DVI 1.0).

ports.name: VGA IN
ports.note: Analog RGBHV, HD-15, 0.7 Vp-p nominal, 75 ohm.

ports.name: Audio In 1
ports.note: Front-panel 3.5 mm stereo jack on the HDMI input module, unbalanced. Panel silkscreen label is 'AUDIO IN' (both audio jacks share this exact label; numbered here for disambiguation).

ports.name: Audio In 2
ports.note: Front-panel 3.5 mm stereo jack on the VGA input module, unbalanced. Panel silkscreen label is 'AUDIO IN'.

ports.name: IR Out
ports.note: 2-pole 3.5 mm captive screw pass-through connector for IR control of a source/sink device.

ports.name: Mini USB (Config)
ports.note: Actual connector is Mini-USB Type B (female); 'usb-b' chosen as closest available enum value (no mini-USB option exists). Used for SIS configuration and firmware updates, not general host/device data.

ports.name: DC Power Input (12V)
ports.note: 2-pole 3.5 mm captive screw connector for the included external 12 VDC, 1.5 A power supply (input 100-240 VAC 50-60 Hz). Unit can alternatively be powered remotely over the DTP line by the receiver.

ports.name: Over DTP
ports.note: Rear-panel 3-pole 3.5 mm captive screw connector; bidirectional RS-232 pass-through, embedded into the DTP link and delivered to the far-end device.

ports.name: Remote
ports.note: Rear-panel 5-pole 3.5 mm captive screw connector; local RS-232 control of the transmitter (9600,8,1,none) plus contact-closure input switching (shared connector).

ports.name: DTP Out
ports.note: Female RJ-45 carrying Extron's proprietary DTP 230 signal (video, audio, and control) up to 230 ft over shielded twisted pair — not a standard Ethernet/network link (manufacturer explicitly warns not to connect to a telecom/data network), so no eth-* grade is assigned. Direction marked bidirectional per RJ-45 convention; can also receive remote power from a compatible DTP receiver/transmitter.
